fusions.name: Report Down the Line
fusions.desc: A cracking throw that deals 32 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range, and ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Fixed Bayonet
fusions.desc: A lunge with the blade under the barrel that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sighted Down the Shaft
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Ball Through Plate
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
